WITH grid AS (
  SELECT ts, book, symbol, last(pos) AS pos, last(cost) AS cost
  FROM energy_positions_running_day
  WHERE ts <= @asof AND (@book = 'ALL' OR book = @book)
  SAMPLE BY 1m FILL(PREV)
),
mk AS (
  SELECT ts, symbol, last(close) AS mark
  FROM energy_quotes_10s
  WHERE ts >= @from AND ts <= @asof
    AND symbol IN (SELECT DISTINCT symbol FROM energy_fills
                   WHERE ts >= @day AND ts <= @asof AND (@book = 'ALL' OR book = @book))
  SAMPLE BY 1m FILL(PREV)
),
fx AS (
  SELECT ts, symbol AS fx_symbol, last(close) AS usd
  FROM energy_quotes_10s
  WHERE symbol IN ('EURUSD', 'GBPUSD', 'EURGBP') AND ts >= @from AND ts <= @asof
  SAMPLE BY 1m FILL(PREV)
),
base AS (
  SELECT symbol, price FROM energy_curve_marks
  WHERE ts <= @from AND ts > dateadd('d', -1, @from)
  LATEST ON ts PARTITION BY symbol
),
fx0 AS (
  SELECT symbol AS fx_symbol, mid(bid, ask) AS usd FROM energy_quotes
  WHERE symbol IN ('EURUSD', 'GBPUSD', 'EURGBP') AND ts <= @from AND ts > dateadd('h', -1, @from)
  LATEST ON ts PARTITION BY symbol
),
pnl AS (
  SELECT g.ts, g.book,
         sum((g.pos * coalesce(m.mark, b.price) - g.cost) * i.px_factor * coalesce(f.usd, f0.usd, 1.0)) AS pnl_usd
  FROM grid g
  LEFT JOIN mk m ON (ts, symbol)
  LEFT JOIN base b ON b.symbol = g.symbol
  JOIN energy_instruments i ON i.symbol = g.symbol
  LEFT JOIN fx f ON f.ts = g.ts AND f.fx_symbol = i.fx_symbol
  LEFT JOIN fx0 f0 ON f0.fx_symbol = i.fx_symbol
  GROUP BY g.ts, g.book
)
SELECT ts, book, pnl_usd FROM pnl WHERE ts >= @from AND ts <= @asof ORDER BY ts, book;

),

         sum((g.pos * coalesce(m.mark, b.price) - g.cost) * i.px_factor * coalesce(f.usd, f0.usd, 1.0)) AS pnl_usd
  FROM grid g

  LEFT JOIN fx f ON f.ts = g.ts AND f.fx_symbol = i.fx_symbol

  GROUP BY g.ts, g.book
),
tot AS (
  SELECT ts, sum(pnl_usd) AS total FROM pnl WHERE ts >= @from AND ts <= @asof GROUP BY ts ORDER BY ts
),
dd AS (
  SELECT ts, total - max(total) OVER (ORDER BY ts) AS drawdown FROM tot
)
SELECT ts, drawdown FROM dd

WITH f AS (
  SELECT symbol, exchange_symbol, curve FROM energy_tenors_asof WHERE tenor IN ('M1', 'Z1')
),
q AS (
  SELECT symbol, source, bid, ask, ts FROM energy_quotes
  WHERE ts <= @asof AND ts > dateadd('m', -10, @asof)
  LATEST ON ts PARTITION BY symbol, source
),
p AS (
  SELECT q.symbol, q.bid, q.ask, q.ts
  FROM q JOIN energy_listings l ON l.symbol = q.symbol AND l.exchange = q.source AND l.is_primary
),
st AS (
  SELECT symbol, price FROM energy_settlements
  WHERE ts < @day AND ts >= dateadd('d', -7, @day)
  LATEST ON ts PARTITION BY symbol
)
SELECT f.symbol, f.exchange_symbol AS exchange, p.bid, p.ask, round(mid(p.bid, p.ask), 3) AS mid,
       round(mid(p.bid, p.ask) - st.price, 3) AS chg,
       round(100 * (mid(p.bid, p.ask) - st.price) / st.price, 2) AS chg_pct,
       round(datediff('T', p.ts::timestamp, @asof) / 1000.0, 1) AS age_s
FROM f
JOIN p ON (symbol)
LEFT JOIN st ON (symbol)
ORDER BY f.curve
cells.name: Front months, live

SELECT * FROM (
  SELECT l.book, l.symbol, li.exchange_symbol AS exchange,
         sum(l.qty) AS position,
         round(last(m.price), 3) AS mark,
         round(sum(CASE WHEN l.src = 'sod' THEN l.qty * (m.price - l.px) * u.factor ELSE 0 END)) AS opening_book_usd,
         round(sum(CASE WHEN l.src = 'trade' THEN l.qty * (m.price - l.px) * u.factor ELSE 0 END)) AS todays_trading_usd,
         round(sum(l.qty * (m.price - l.px) * u.factor)) AS total_pnl_usd
  FROM energy_ledger l
  JOIN energy_marks_live m ON (symbol)
  JOIN energy_usd_factor_asof u ON (symbol)
  JOIN (SELECT symbol, exchange_symbol FROM energy_listings WHERE is_primary) li ON (symbol)
  WHERE l.ts >= @day AND l.ts <= @asof AND (@book = 'ALL' OR l.book = @book)
  GROUP BY l.book, l.symbol, li.exchange_symbol
  ORDER BY l.book, l.symbol
)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Total', NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL,
       round(sum(CASE WHEN l.src = 'sod' THEN l.qty * (m.price - l.px) * u.factor ELSE 0 END)),
       round(sum(CASE WHEN l.src = 'trade' THEN l.qty * (m.price - l.px) * u.factor ELSE 0 END)),
       round(sum(l.qty * (m.price - l.px) * u.factor))
FROM energy_ledger l
JOIN energy_marks_live m ON (symbol)
JOIN energy_usd_factor_asof u ON (symbol)
WHERE l.ts >= @day AND l.ts <= @asof AND (@book = 'ALL' OR l.book = @book)

WITH sod AS (
  SELECT book, curve, sum(qty) AS qty FROM energy_position_snapshots
  WHERE ts = @day AND (@book = 'ALL' OR book = @book)
  GROUP BY book, curve
),
traded AS (
  SELECT ts, book, curve, sum(qty) OVER (PARTITION BY book, curve ORDER BY ts) AS traded
  FROM energy_fills
  WHERE ts >= @day AND ts <= @asof AND (@book = 'ALL' OR book = @book)
),
running AS (
  SELECT @day AS ts, book, curve, qty AS net_qty FROM sod
  UNION ALL
  SELECT t.ts, t.book, t.curve, coalesce(s.qty, 0) + t.traded AS net_qty
  FROM traded t LEFT JOIN sod s ON (book, curve)
),
ordered AS (
  SELECT * FROM running ORDER BY ts
),
lim AS (
  SELECT book, curve, max_abs_qty FROM energy_limits
  LATEST ON ts PARTITION BY book, curve
)
SELECT r.book, r.curve,
       round(100 * abs(last(r.net_qty)) / l.max_abs_qty) AS pct_now,
       round(100 * max(abs(r.net_qty)) / l.max_abs_qty) AS pct_peak
FROM ordered r
JOIN lim l ON (book, curve)
GROUP BY r.book, r.curve, l.max_abs_qty
ORDER BY pct_peak DESC
cells.name: Limit utilisation, now and intraday peak

SELECT t.delivery_start AS delivery, m.price AS mark_as_of_range_end, s.price AS last_settlement
FROM energy_marks_live m
JOIN energy_tenors_asof t ON (symbol)
LEFT JOIN (SELECT symbol, price FROM energy_settlements
           WHERE curve = @curve AND ts < @day AND ts >= dateadd('d', -7, @day)
           LATEST ON ts PARTITION BY symbol) s ON (symbol)
WHERE m.curve = @curve AND t.granularity IN ('M', 'Z')
ORDER BY t.delivery_start

WITH ev AS (
  SELECT e.booked_ts, e.trade_ts, e.trade_id, e.version,
         CASE WHEN e.status = 'CANCELLED' THEN 0.0
              ELSE e.qty * (m.price - e.px) * u.factor END AS value_usd
  FROM energy_trade_events e
  JOIN energy_marks_asof m ON (symbol)
  JOIN energy_usd_factor_asof u ON (symbol)
  WHERE e.booked_ts >= @day AND e.booked_ts <= @asof
    AND e.trade_ts >= @day AND e.trade_ts <= @asof
    AND (@book = 'ALL' OR e.book = @book)
),
steps AS (
  SELECT booked_ts AS ts,
         value_usd - coalesce(lag(value_usd) OVER (PARTITION BY trade_id ORDER BY booked_ts, version), 0.0) AS delta
  FROM ev
  UNION ALL SELECT @day AS ts, 0.0 AS delta FROM long_sequence(1)
  UNION ALL SELECT @asof AS ts, 0.0 AS delta FROM long_sequence(1)
),
known AS (
  SELECT ts, sum(delta) OVER (ORDER BY ts) AS v FROM steps ORDER BY ts
)
SELECT * FROM (
  SELECT ts, last(v) AS book_as_known
  FROM (known TIMESTAMP(ts))
  SAMPLE BY 1m FILL(PREV)
) WHERE ts >= @from AND ts <= @asof;
WITH ev AS (
  SELECT e.booked_ts, e.trade_ts, e.trade_id, e.version,
         CASE WHEN e.status = 'CANCELLED' THEN 0.0
              ELSE e.qty * (m.price - e.px) * u.factor END AS value_usd
  FROM energy_trade_events e
  JOIN energy_marks_asof m ON (symbol)
  JOIN energy_usd_factor_asof u ON (symbol)
  WHERE e.booked_ts >= @day AND e.booked_ts <= @asof
    AND e.trade_ts >= @day AND e.trade_ts <= @asof
    AND (@book = 'ALL' OR e.book = @book)
),
fin AS (
  SELECT trade_ts AS ts, value_usd FROM (
    SELECT trade_ts, value_usd,
           row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY trade_id ORDER BY booked_ts DESC, version DESC) AS rn
    FROM ev)
  WHERE rn = 1
  UNION ALL SELECT @day AS ts, 0.0 AS value_usd FROM long_sequence(1)
  UNION ALL SELECT @asof AS ts, 0.0 AS value_usd FROM long_sequence(1)
),
restated AS (
  SELECT ts, sum(value_usd) OVER (ORDER BY ts) AS v FROM fin ORDER BY ts
)
SELECT * FROM (
  SELECT ts, last(v) AS book_as_restated
  FROM (restated TIMESTAMP(ts))
  SAMPLE BY 1m FILL(PREV)
) WHERE ts >= @from AND ts <= @asof
cells.name: Book as known versus as restated, USD

WITH b1 AS (
  (SELECT * FROM energy_trade_events
   WHERE booked_ts >= timestamp_floor('d', @from) AND booked_ts <= @from
   LATEST ON booked_ts PARTITION BY trade_id)
  WHERE status != 'CANCELLED' AND trade_ts >= timestamp_floor('d', @from) AND trade_ts <= @from
    AND (@book = 'ALL' OR book = @book)
),
b2 AS (
  (SELECT * FROM energy_trade_events
   WHERE booked_ts >= timestamp_floor('d', @from) AND booked_ts <= @asof
   LATEST ON booked_ts PARTITION BY trade_id)
  WHERE status != 'CANCELLED' AND trade_ts >= timestamp_floor('d', @from) AND trade_ts <= @asof
    AND (@book = 'ALL' OR book = @book)
),
both AS (
  SELECT coalesce(b1.symbol, b2.symbol) AS symbol,
         b1.qty AS q1, b1.px AS p1, b2.qty AS q2, b2.px AS p2, b2.trade_ts AS ts2
  FROM b1 FULL JOIN b2 ON b1.trade_id = b2.trade_id
),
m1 AS (SELECT symbol, price FROM energy_curve_marks WHERE ts <= @from AND ts > dateadd('m', -5, @from) LATEST ON ts PARTITION BY symbol),
m2 AS (SELECT symbol, price FROM energy_curve_marks WHERE ts <= @asof AND ts > dateadd('m', -5, @asof) LATEST ON ts PARTITION BY symbol),
f1 AS (SELECT symbol, mid(bid, ask) AS usd FROM energy_quotes
       WHERE symbol IN ('EURUSD', 'GBPUSD', 'EURGBP') AND ts <= @from AND ts > dateadd('h', -1, @from) LATEST ON ts PARTITION BY symbol),
f2 AS (SELECT symbol, mid(bid, ask) AS usd FROM energy_quotes
       WHERE symbol IN ('EURUSD', 'GBPUSD', 'EURGBP') AND ts <= @asof AND ts > dateadd('h', -1, @asof) LATEST ON ts PARTITION BY symbol),
x AS (
  SELECT t.q1, t.p1, t.q2, t.p2, t.ts2, a.price AS m1, b.price AS m2,
         c.px_factor * coalesce(u1.usd, 1.0) AS k1, c.px_factor * coalesce(u2.usd, 1.0) AS k2
  FROM both t
  JOIN m1 a ON a.symbol = t.symbol
  JOIN m2 b ON b.symbol = t.symbol
  JOIN energy_instruments c ON c.symbol = t.symbol
  LEFT JOIN f1 u1 ON u1.symbol = c.fx_symbol
  LEFT JOIN f2 u2 ON u2.symbol = c.fx_symbol
),
s AS (
  SELECT sum(CASE WHEN q1 IS NOT NULL THEN q1 * ((m2 - p1) * k2 - (m1 - p1) * k1) ELSE 0 END) AS market_move,
         sum(CASE WHEN q1 IS NULL AND ts2 > @from THEN q2 * (m2 - p2) * k2 ELSE 0 END) AS new_trades,
         sum(CASE WHEN q1 IS NULL AND ts2 <= @from THEN q2 * (m2 - p2) * k2 ELSE 0 END) AS late_bookings,
         sum(CASE WHEN q1 IS NOT NULL AND q2 IS NOT NULL THEN (q2 * (m2 - p2) - q1 * (m2 - p1)) * k2 ELSE 0 END) AS amendments,
         sum(CASE WHEN q2 IS NULL THEN -q1 * (m2 - p1) * k2 ELSE 0 END) AS cancellations,
         sum(CASE WHEN q2 IS NOT NULL THEN q2 * (m2 - p2) * k2 ELSE 0 END)
           - sum(CASE WHEN q1 IS NOT NULL THEN q1 * (m1 - p1) * k1 ELSE 0 END) AS total
  FROM x
)
SELECT 'Market move' AS component, round(market_move) AS usd FROM s
UNION ALL SELECT 'New trades', round(new_trades) FROM s
UNION ALL SELECT 'Late bookings', round(late_bookings) FROM s
UNION ALL SELECT 'Amendments', round(amendments) FROM s
UNION ALL SELECT 'Cancellations', round(cancellations) FROM s
UNION ALL SELECT 'Total', round(total) FROM s
cells.name: PnL explain across the time range, USD
